description: Single-row configuration for ranked-match point changes after a battle.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_RankPointCalculation. The consumer does not search by a literal id: it takes the first row name of the first RankPointCalculationDataTables table that has rows and finds that row. The supplied export has one row named DEFAULT.

Result_Win.simple: Base rank-point delta for a win.
Result_Win.technical: int32. AGameBattleManager::CalcRankPointDelta selects it when the player's team is the winner (winner team != 0xFF). Further evaluation, force-gauge, rank-gap and loss-floor adjustments are applied afterwards; a draw uses Result_Draw and a loss uses Result_Lose.

Result_Lose.simple: Base rank-point delta for a loss.
Result_Lose.technical: int32. Selected when the winner team differs from the player's team. After other modifiers, a losing player's points are raised to the active RankPoint row's LoseLowerLimit (and to at least 0 when an AI-controlled ally flag is set). Draw results instead clamp the final points to <= 0.

Result_Draw.simple: Base rank-point delta for a draw.
Result_Draw.technical: int32. Selected when GetWinnerTeam() returns 0xFF; the final adjusted value is clamped with FMath::Min(Points, 0).

Evaluation_S.simple: Point adjustment for an S result evaluation.
Evaluation_S.technical: int32 added to the base result when the battle evaluation rank is 4 (S). Other evaluation ranks use their own fields; unrecognised ranks add nothing.

Evaluation_A.simple: Point adjustment for an A result evaluation.
Evaluation_A.technical: int32 added when evaluation rank is 3 (A).

Evaluation_B.simple: Point adjustment for a B result evaluation.
Evaluation_B.technical: int32 added when evaluation rank is 2 (B).

Evaluation_C.simple: Point adjustment for a C result evaluation.
Evaluation_C.technical: int32 added when evaluation rank is 1 (C). Exported DEFAULT values are S=10, A=5, B=0, C=-5.

ForceGaugeRate.simple: Points added per remaining stock difference.
ForceGaugeRate.technical: int32 multiplier applied to (player character stock - rival stock). The stock values come from GetCharacterStock for the player and rival team; the product is added to the result/evaluation total before rank-gap scaling.

RankGapThreshold.simple: Rank-point gap that triggers loss mitigation.
RankGapThreshold.technical: int32. The consumer averages online users' RankPoint values on each team; if (enemy average - ally average) >= this threshold and the player is on the losing team, the accumulated delta is scaled by RankGapRate.

RankGapRate.simple: Multiplier applied to a mitigated loss.
RankGapRate.technical: float. Points are cast to float, multiplied by this rate and truncated back to int32 when the RankGapThreshold/loser-team condition holds. Exported DEFAULT uses 0.2.

notes: The exported asset has exactly one row (DEFAULT) with FGameDataTableRow_RankPointCalculation; the manager loads RankPointCalculationDataTable into RankPointCalculationDataTables (DTM+0x390).
The row-selection helper reads the first row name of the first non-empty table rather than searching for DEFAULT by name, so table row order is significant if more rows are added.
The consumer CalcRankPointDelta is reconstructed at retail RVA 0x104bdf0; consult status/functions.json for byte status. Only available C++ and the export were reviewed.

usages.detail: BattleManager_FirstRankPointCalculationRow picks the first row of the first non-empty table.
CalcRankPointDelta applies result, evaluation, stock-gap and rank-gap fields.
Cross-table join to RankPoint.LoseLowerLimit clamps a loss after calculation.
